prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate for a 2D Godot player-body sprite master. Use the approved A style-lock reference for bold tactical graphic illustration, chunky readable silhouette, precise hard-surface armor planes, and restrained hand-painted cel shading. Create one compact cyber-wasteland operative body in a consistent top-down three-quarter view, neutral right-facing master pose, dominant cyan faction lighting, tiny restrained magenta bounce, worn dark composite armor and dusty synthetic fabric. Exclude every weapon so the independently rotating primary weapon can be layered separately. Center the visual mass over the collision center, keep feet and contact points balanced, keep transparent padding below ten percent, and preserve readability at 64x64. Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local removal; the background must have no gradients, shadows, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 in the subject. No text, border, watermark, scenery, cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, cropped anatomy, loose cables, excessive bloom, or opaque halo.
negative_constraints: no weapon or firearm attached to the body
no acid green in the subject
